children: JB Hi-Fi's main division in Australia missed expectations for 1Q same-store sales by 40 basis points, RBC Capital Markets says. That's significant because JB Hi-Fi Australia accounts for some 75% of group Ebit. Still, analyst Michael Toner suggests several factors could cushion the stock impact. They include product release cycles in 2Q, a stronger showing for The Good Guys and JB Hi-Fi's New Zealand business and low market expectations heading into today's update. "We also however note management commentary "in October, the Group has seen sales slow ahead of the important Black Friday and Christmas trading periods" suggesting a deterioration after today's update," RBC says. It had a sector perform call and A$73.00/share price target on JB Hi-Fi, which ended Wednesday at A$70.66. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
